func typechecker_rfind_char(s: str, ch: int, end_idx: int) int {
    mut j := end_idx - 1;
    while j >= 0 {
        if std.str_byte_at(s, j) == ch {
            return j;
        }
        j = j - 1;
    }
    return 0 - 1;
}
